description: SEC-002 (HIGH): Add per-request HMAC signature verification to prevent Edge shared secret trust bypass. Edge should sign requests with HMAC-SHA256(secret, timestamp + user_id + path) and backend should verify the signature and reject stale requests (>30s old).
steps: 1. In apps/edge/src/routes/api-proxy.ts, add HMAC signature generation: Before forwarding, compute HMAC-SHA256 of (timestamp + userId + pathname) using the EDGE_SHARED_SECRET as key. Set headers X-Edge-Signature and X-Edge-Timestamp on the proxied request. Use the Web Crypto API (crypto.subtle) for HMAC generation. The userId comes from the X-User-ID header already set. Import or inline the necessary crypto logic.

2. In apps/edge/src/index.ts, ensure the X-User-ID header is set BEFORE the request reaches the proxy function (it already is in step 2 of the pipeline). No changes needed here if the flow already sets X-User-ID before proxy.

3. In apps/backend/app/api/v1/auth.py, update the get_current_user function's edge-trust bypass section: Instead of just comparing X-Edge-Secret, verify the HMAC signature. Extract X-Edge-Signature and X-Edge-Timestamp headers. Compute expected signature = HMAC-SHA256(EDGE_SHARED_SECRET, timestamp + user_id + request.url.path). Compare signatures using hmac.compare_digest. Reject if timestamp is older than 30 seconds. Keep backward compatibility: if X-Edge-Signature is not present but X-Edge-Secret matches, log a deprecation warning and allow (for rollover period).
4. Apply the same HMAC verification logic to get_current_user_optional in the same file.
5. Add a helper function _verify_edge_signature(request, edge_secret) in auth.py that encapsulates the HMAC verification logic, returning (valid: bool, user_id: str | None).
acceptance_criteria: Edge proxy sends X-Edge-Signature (hex-encoded HMAC-SHA256) and X-Edge-Timestamp headers
Backend verifies HMAC signature in edge-trust bypass path
Backend rejects requests with timestamps older than 30 seconds
Backward compatible: requests with only X-Edge-Secret (no signature) still work with a deprecation warning
TypeScript compiles without errors for edge
Python files have no syntax errors
